ranked.headline: Coupling histology and spatial context with gene-level priors in spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Preprints and publications now couple histology, spatial graphs, and regularization with gene-level spatial transcriptomics modeling.

ranked.headline: Computational models link chromatin features to expression, mutation and contacts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply statistical and learned models to multiple epigenomic layers to predict expression, mutation rates and chromatin contacts.

ranked.headline: Fusing multi-source features and transfer learning in biological prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal papers extend pretrained embeddings, graph models, and transfer learning to gene, protein, drug, and genomic prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: New computational methods refine single-cell annotation and trajectory inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study target annotation reliability and reference-relative disease scoring across single-cell datasets.

ranked.headline: Graph learning fuses network views to predict drug interactions and targets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair graph encoders with causal, reinforcement, or Kolmogorov-Arnold learning objectives for drug and target prioritisation.

ranked.headline: Constraint-aware learning models couple molecular structure, spectra, and phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative and representation models with hard chemical, mass, and flow-based constraints for molecular design and analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational models span antibody design, immune checkpoints and B cell affinity
ranked.summary: Single-cell, structure-based and generative tools now target antibody affinity, immunophenotyping and immune checkpoint modulation in recent preprints and…

ranked.headline: Pattern-level statistical testing and comparison methods for spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce calibrated, scalable tests for spatial patterns across transcriptomic and single-molecule spatial omics modalities.

ranked.headline: Joint statistical modeling of variants across traits, predictors and genomic layers
ranked.summary: Variant pathogenicity, fine-mapping and diagnostic methods are moving toward joint models benchmarked against explicit ceilings and baselines.

ranked.headline: Methylation-based models track epigenetic aging and tumor cfDNA across data types
ranked.summary: Methylation and transcriptomic profiling now feed computational scores for aging, cancer detection and microbial contamination calls.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biomolecular encoders are reused for fitness, function, and enzyme prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether causal protein models, distogram representations, and evolution-informed pretraining transfer to fitness and function tasks.

ranked.headline: Omics analysis software is benchmarked and released for multi-modal data integration
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks quantify how parameter settings and tool choice shape single-cell and variant-prioritization results.

ranked.headline: Inferring mutation timing and rates from sequencing data with structural constraints
ranked.summary: Cross-sectional single-cell data and pedigree sequencing are being used to recover mutation timing, selection, and rates from static samples.

ranked.headline: Generative models sample protein and GPCR dynamics and cryo-EM density representations
ranked.summary: Preprints now use learned generative models to produce protein trajectories and GPCR-ligand dynamics, targeting costly simulation.

ranked.headline: Strain-resolved and k-mer-based metagenomic profiling extends sample classification
ranked.summary: Pangenome graphs and long-read pipelines are pushing metagenomic analysis toward strain resolution and near-complete genome recovery.

ranked.headline: Graph and flow-matching models encode regulatory structure into single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications encode gene regulatory networks and Boolean dynamics into models for scRNA-seq-based inference.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks standardize mass spectrometry measurements across instruments and batches
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply benchmark datasets, batch-correction comparisons, and QC software to make MS measurements comparable across platforms.

ranked.headline: Software integrates multi-omics layers across cell communication and metabolic modeling
ranked.summary: Five February 2026 Bioinformatics tool papers extend multi-omics analysis to cell communication, metabolism, module discovery, and genome structure.

ranked.headline: Bias-aware methods sharpen coverage, splicing, and small RNA measurements
ranked.summary: Recent work targets protocol-dependent bias in coverage, circRNA calls, and sncRNA ligation, enabling per-cell and absolute readouts.

ranked.headline: Learned delineation of tissue and structures in gigapixel digital pathology imaging
ranked.summary: Foundation-model adaptation now yields faster whole-slide patch extraction and cellular-resolution tissue masks for pathology and spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Ensemble-level models resolve conformational heterogeneity in disordered proteins
ranked.summary: Single-structure descriptions fail for disordered and folding systems, motivating restraint-guided and coarse-grained ensemble methods.

ranked.headline: Python tools link protein sequence variation, pKa shifts, and genotype-phenotype maps
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 publications release Python tools for alignment-based variation, MD-trajectory pKa tracking, and genotype-phenotype mapping.

ranked.headline: Latent-variable and mechanistic models target hidden structure in neural activity data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair Poisson latent gradients, LLM-driven model discovery, and causal representation learning with neural data benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design and data splitting govern reported accuracy in biological models
ranked.summary: Recent items address benchmark construction, QSAR data partitioning, and standardized evaluation of drug-response measurements in predictive modeling.

ranked.headline: Nanopore and GPU pipelines lower compute cost for genome assembly and telomere analysis
ranked.summary: Recomputable, low-cost processing matters for population-scale pangenomics and telomere-resolved nanopore assembly work.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict RNA structural ensembles, RNA editability, and Cas PAM specificity
ranked.summary: Three February 2026 items apply structure- and evolution-informed deep learning to RNA ensembles, A-to-I editability, and CRISPR-Cas PAM specificity.

ranked.headline: Models show electric fields override durotaxis; branched cells reorient in chemotaxis
ranked.summary: Scalable solvers and cell-level models now resolve how electric fields, substrate stiffness, and geometry steer cell transport and migration.

ranked.headline: Likelihood models of evolution are tested against neural networks and simulated bias
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether parameter-light likelihood models can match neural alternatives and whether neutral models mislead under selection.

ranked.headline: Scalable phylogenetic network, tree, and pangenome MUM methods
ranked.summary: Scaling to hundreds of haplotypes and large taxon sets now requires methods that also remain reproducible across parallel core counts.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools standardize and democratize downstream analysis of biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair multi-instrument standardization with natural-language plotting, pointing to interface-driven analysis workflows for expert users.

ranked.headline: Multi-ancestry GWAS tools extend conditional, joint and meta-analysis methods
ranked.summary: Diverse-ancestry GWAS require summary-statistic tools for conditional, joint and meta-analytic inference that scale across populations.

ranked.headline: Geometric and graph learning models membrane protein and peptide interactions
ranked.summary: Learned geometric and graph representations now predict membrane contact and binding sites, with MD simulations used for training or validation.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies of polyploid and heterozygous plant genomes
ranked.summary: Haplotype-phased long-read and Hi-C assembly now yields near telomere-to-telomere autotetraploid potato genomes, with apple and Arabidopsis work following.

ranked.headline: Flexibility-aware ligand design and metal-site prediction in protein structures
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether design and site-prediction tools can handle induced fit and transition metal chemistries beyond their training data.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines and knowledge graphs link genetic and molecular data to drug repurposing
ranked.summary: Packaged, open workflows now connect GWAS, LLM-extracted interactions, and negative-sample design to drug repurposing in a reusable form.

ranked.headline: Orthology-based tools make comparative phylogenomic and proteomic analysis accessible
ranked.summary: Recent tools package orthology, tree-based trait profiling, and enrichment into accessible software for comparative analysis.

ranked.headline: Large genome cohorts link copy number and oligogenic variants to disease traits
ranked.summary: Population-scale genomes now allow variant-trait mapping that extends beyond single common variants to copy number changes and multi-gene interactions.
